theorems.name: Submission.canonical_representatives
theorems.statement: ApproxTangentAE → (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → CanonicalRepresentative ∧ LpSupportRepresentation
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
